A 500,000 gallon storage tank is drawn down to a one-third of the total volume during daily use. How much water remains in the tank?\ \*a. 166,667 gal\ **Solution:**\ $500,000 \times \dfrac{1}{3} = \boxed{166,667}$
b. 333,333 gal\
c. 300,000 gal\
d. 500,000 gal\

Convert $22\dfrac{1}{4}$ into a fraction.\ \*b. $\dfrac{89}{4}$\ **Solution:**\ $=\dfrac{22\times4 + 1}{4}=\boxed{\dfrac{89}{4}}$
a. $\dfrac{45}{4}$\
c. $\dfrac{21}{4}$\
d. $\dfrac{88}{4}$\

Express 10 ft 6 in as a fraction.\ \*c. $\dfrac{21}{2}$\ **Solution:**\ $6" = 6\text{ in} \times \dfrac{\text{ft}}{12\text{ in}} = \dfrac{6}{12}=\dfrac{1}{2}\text{ ft} \implies 10\text{ ft }6\text{ in} = 10\dfrac{1}{2}\text{ ft} = \boxed{\dfrac{21}{2}\text{ ft}}$
a. $\dfrac{20}{2}$\
b. $\dfrac{10}{2}$\
d. $\dfrac{22}{2}$\

A 400,000-gallon reservoir is filled to $\dfrac{3}{5}$ of its capacity. How many gallons are in the tank?\ \*a. 240,000 gal\ **Solution:**\ $400,000\times\dfrac{3}{5}=\boxed{240,000\text{ gal}}$
b. 300,000 gal\
c. 200,000 gal\
d. 350,000 gal\

A storage tank holds 1.2 million gallons. If it is drained to $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of capacity, how much water has been used?\ \*b. 900,000 gal\ **Solution:**\ $\text{Used} = 1.2\times10^6 - \dfrac{1}{4}(1.2\times10^6)=0.75\times1.2\times10^6=\boxed{900,000\text{ gal}}$
a. 300,000 gal\
c. 1,200,000 gal\
d. 600,000 gal\

Convert $2.75$ ft into a mixed fraction.\ \*a. $2\dfrac{3}{4}$\ **Solution:**\ $0.75 = \dfrac{3}{4} \implies 2.75 = \boxed{2\dfrac{3}{4} = \dfrac{11}{4}}$
b. $2\dfrac{1}{2}$\
c. $2\dfrac{2}{3}$\
d. $2\dfrac{5}{8}$\

Add $4\dfrac{1}{3}+2\dfrac{5}{6}$.\ \*b. $7\dfrac{1}{6}$\ **Solution:**\ Convert to improper fractions:\ $\dfrac{13}{3}+\dfrac{17}{6}=\dfrac{26}{6}+\dfrac{17}{6}=\dfrac{43}{6}=\boxed{7\dfrac{1}{6}}$
a. $6\dfrac{1}{3}$\
c. $7\dfrac{1}{2}$\
d. $8\dfrac{1}{6}$\

The flow rate in a pipe is $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of the design capacity of 800 gpm. What is the actual flow?\ \*a. 600 gpm\ **Solution:**\ $800\times\dfrac{3}{4}=\boxed{600\text{ gpm}}$
b. 650 gpm\
c. 550 gpm\
d. 700 gpm\

A 1,200,000-gallon storage tank is filled to $\dfrac{5}{6}$ of its total capacity. How much water is in the tank?\ \*a. 1,000,000 gal\ **Solution:**\ $1,200,000 \times \dfrac{5}{6} = \boxed{1,000,000\text{ gal}}$
b. 900,000 gal\
c. 800,000 gal\
d. 700,000 gal\

A 500,000-gallon reservoir is drained to $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of its capacity. How much water was used?\ \*b. 300,000 gal\ **Solution:**\ $\text{Used} = 500,000 - 500,000\times\dfrac{2}{5} = 500,000 - 200,000 = \boxed{300,000\text{ gal}}$
a. 100,000 gal\
c. 200,000 gal\
d. 350,000 gal\

A chemical tank contains 80 gallons of sodium hypochlorite solution. If $\dfrac{3}{8}$ of the tank is used each day, how many gallons are used per day?\ \*b. 30 gal\ **Solution:**\ $80 \times \dfrac{3}{8} = \boxed{30\text{ gal/day}}$
a. 10 gal\
c. 25 gal\
d. 35 gal\

A 36-inch water main is reduced to $\dfrac{3}{4}$ flow due to maintenance. What fraction of the cross-sectional area remains open?\ \*b. $\left(\dfrac{3}{4}\right)^2 = \dfrac{9}{16}$\ **Solution:**\ Area $\propto D^2 \implies \left(\dfrac{3}{4}\right)^2=\boxed{\dfrac{9}{16}}$
a. $\dfrac{1}{2}$\
c. $\dfrac{3}{8}$\
d. $\dfrac{7}{8}$\

A pump runs 12 hours per day. If it operates at $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of full capacity, how many equivalent full-capacity hours does it operate?\ \*a. 8 hours\ **Solution:**\ $12\times\dfrac{2}{3}=\boxed{8\text{ hours}}$
b. 6 hours\
c. 9 hours\
d. 7 hours\

A lime slurry feed tank is $\dfrac{5}{8}$ full. If the total capacity is 400 gallons, how many gallons are in the tank?\ \*b. 250 gal\ **Solution:**\ $400\times\dfrac{5}{8}=\boxed{250\text{ gal}}$
a. 200 gal\
c. 275 gal\
d. 300 gal\

A pipe delivers water at a rate of 900 gpm for $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of an hour. How many gallons are delivered?\ \*a. 36,000 gal\ **Solution:**\ $900\text{ gpm}\times 60\text{ min/hr}\times\dfrac{2}{3}\text{ hr}=900\times40=\boxed{36,000\text{ gal}}$
b. 27,000 gal\
c. 30,000 gal\
d. 24,000 gal\

A 40 ft pipe section is cut into $\dfrac{5}{8}$ of its original length. What is the new pipe length?\ \*a. 25 ft\ **Solution:**\ $40\times\dfrac{5}{8}=\boxed{25\text{ ft}}$
b. 20 ft\
c. 30 ft\
d. 35 ft\

An operator uses $\dfrac{1}{6}$ lb of polymer per 1000 gallons of water. If the plant treats 9 MGD, how many pounds of polymer are used daily?\ \*a. 1,500 lb/day\ **Solution:**\ $9,000,000\text{ gal/day}\times\dfrac{1}{6}\text{ lb/1000 gal}=\dfrac{9,000,000}{1000}\times\dfrac{1}{6}=9000\times\dfrac{1}{6}=\boxed{1,500\text{ lb/day}}$
b. 900 lb/day\
c. 600 lb/day\
d. 2,000 lb/day\

A backwash basin holds $\dfrac{3}{4}$ of its 80,000-gallon capacity. If 20% of that volume is discharged during backwash, how many gallons are released?\ \*b. 12,000 gal\ **Solution:**\ $80,000\times\dfrac{3}{4}\times0.20=60,000\times0.20=\boxed{12,000\text{ gal}}$
a. 10,000 gal\
c. 14,000 gal\
d. 15,000 gal\
